236 struct

243 struct

247 wxCoord x2;

259 }
260};

268template<typename T>
269struct mpRange
270{
271 T min = 0;
272 T max = 0;
273
275 mpRange()
276 {
277 min = 0;
278 max = 0;
279 }
280
282 mpRange(T value1, T value2)
283 {
284 if (value1 < value2)
285 {
286 min = value1;
287 max = value2;
288 }
289 else
290 {
291 min = value2;
292 max = value1;
293 }
294 }
295
297 void Set(T value_)
298 {
299 min = value_;
300 max = value_;
301 }
302
304 void Set(T min_, T max_)
305 {
306 min = min_;
307 max = max_;
308 }
309
311 void SetMin(T min_)
312 {
313 min = min_;
314 if (max < min)
315 max = min;
316 }
317
319 void SetMax(T max_)
320 {
321 max = max_;
322 if (min > max)
323 min = max;
324 }
325
327 void Assign(T value1, T value2)
328 {
329 if (value1 < value2)
330 {
331 min = value1;
332 max = value2;
333 }
334 else
335 {
336 min = value2;
337 max = value1;
338 }
339 }
340
342 bool IsSet() const
343 {
344 return ((min != 0) || (max != 0));
345 }
346
351 void Update(T value)
352 {
353 if (value < min)
354 min = value;
355 else if (value > max)
356 max = value;
357 }
358
362 void Update(T min_, T max_)
363 {
364 if (min_ < min)
365 min = min_;
366 if (max_ > max)
367 max = max_;
368 }
369
372 void Update(mpRange range)
373 {
374 if (range.min < min)
375 min = range.min;
376 if (range.max > max)
377 max = range.max;
378 }
379
381 void Check(void)
382 {
383 if (min == max)
384 {
385 if (max > 0)
386 min = 0;
387 else
388 max = 0;
389 }
390 }
391
393 T Length(void) const
394 {
395 return max - min;
396 }
397
399 T GetCenter(void) const
400 {
401 return (min + max) / 2;
402 }
403
405 T GetMaxAbs(void) const
406 {
407 return std::max(fabs(min), fabs(max));
408 }
409
411 void ToLog(void)
412 {
413 min = (min > 0) ? log10(min) : 0;
414 max = (max > 0) ? log10(max) : 0;
415 }
416
418 bool PointIsInside(T point) const
419 {
420 return ((point >= min) && (point <= max));
421 }
422
423 #if (defined(__cplusplus) && (__cplusplus > 201703L)) // C++20 or newer
424 bool operator==(const mpRange&) const = default;
425 #else
427 bool operator==(const mpRange &other) const
428 {
429 return (min == other.min) && (max == other.max);
430 }
432 bool operator!=(const mpRange& other) const
433 {
434 return !(*this == other);
435 }
436 #endif
437};

444struct [[deprecated("Deprecated! No longer used as X and Y are now separated")]] mpFloatRect
445{
446 mpRange<double> x;
447 std::vector<mpRange<double>> y;
448
455 mpFloatRect(mpWindow& w);
456
458 mpFloatRect() = delete;
459
466 bool PointIsInside(const double px, const double py, const size_t yAxisID = 0) const {
467 if (yAxisID < y.size())
468 {
469 if( (px < x.min || px > x.max) ||
470 (py < y[yAxisID].min || py > y[yAxisID].max))
471 {
472 return false;
473 }
474 }
475 else
476 {
477 return false;
478 }
479
480 return true;
481 }
482
489 void UpdateBoundingBoxToInclude(const double px, const double py, const size_t yAxisID = 0) {
490 assert(yAxisID < y.size());
491 if (yAxisID < y.size())
492 {
493 if (px < x.min ) x.min = px;
494 else if (px > x.max ) x.max = px;
495 if (py < y[yAxisID].min ) y[yAxisID].min = py;
496 else if (py > y[yAxisID].max ) y[yAxisID].max = py;
497 }
498 }
499
506 void InitializeBoundingBox(const double px, const double py, const size_t yAxisID = 0) {
507 assert(yAxisID < y.size());
508 if (yAxisID < y.size())
509 {
510 x.min = x.max = px;
511 y[yAxisID].min = y[yAxisID].max = py;
512 }
513 }
515 bool IsNotSet(mpWindow& w) const { const mpFloatRect def(w); return *this==def; }
517#if (defined(__cplusplus) && (__cplusplus > 201703L)) // C++ > C++17 (MSVC requires <AdditionalOptions>/Zc:__cplusplus</AdditionalOptions>
518 bool operator==(const mpFloatRect&) const = default;
519#else
520 // We compare with an epsilon precision
521 // NOTE: should be unnecessary as we are looking for any changes; normally this will be an exact match or a real change...
522 bool operator==(const mpFloatRect& rect) const
523 {
524 auto Same = [](const double a, const double b) {
525 return std::fabs(a - b) < MP_EPSILON;
526 };
527
528 // Compare scalar members
529 if (!Same(x.min, rect.x.min) || !Same(x.max, rect.x.max))
530 {
531 return false;
532 }
533
534 // Compare vector sizes
535 if (y.size() != rect.y.size())
536 {
537 return false;
538 }
539
540 // Compare each Y boundary
541 for (size_t i = 0; i < y.size(); ++i)
542 {
543 if (!Same(y[i].min, rect.y[i].min) ||
544 !Same(y[i].max, rect.y[i].max) )
545 {
546 return false;
547 }
548 }
549
550 return true;
551 }
552#endif
553};

560struct mpFloatRectSimple
561{
562 mpRange<double> x;
563 mpRange<double> y;
564
570 mpFloatRectSimple(const mpRange<double> x_, const mpRange<double> y_) : x(x_), y(y_) { };
571
577 bool PointIsInside(const double px, const double py) const {
578 return x.PointIsInside(px) && y.PointIsInside(py);
579 }
580
586 void UpdateBoundingBoxToInclude(const double px, const double py)
587 {
588 x.Update(px);
589 y.Update(py);
590 }
591
596 void InitializeBoundingBox(const double px, const double py)
597 {
598 x.Set(px, px);
599 y.Set(py, py);
600 }
601};

2479class mpFXGeneric: public mpFX
2480{
2481 public:
2486 mpFXGeneric(const wxString &name = wxT("Generic FX function"), const int flags = mpALIGN_LEFT, const unsigned int yAxisID = 0) :
2487 mpFX(name, flags, yAxisID)
2488 {
2489 const wxPen FXpen(*wxBLUE, 1, wxPENSTYLE_SOLID);
2490 SetDrawOutsideMargins(false);
2491 SetContinuity(true);
2492 SetPen(FXpen);
2493 SetStep(8); // Draw one point over eight
2494 }
2495
2500 double GetY(const double x) override
2501 {
2502 double y;
2503 try
2504 {
2505 y = ComputeY(x);
2506 }
2507 catch (...)
2508 {
2509 y = 0;
2510 }
2511 m_rangeY.Update(y);
2512 return y;
2513 }
2514
2519 double GetMinY() override
2520 {
2521 return m_rangeY.min;
2522 }
2523
2528 double GetMaxY() override
2529 {
2530 return m_rangeY.max;
2531 }
2532
2533 protected:
2534 mpRange<double> m_rangeY;
2535
2541 virtual double ComputeY(double x) = 0;
2542
2543 private:
2544 DECLARE_DYNAMIC_CLASS_MATHPLOT(mpFXGeneric);
2545};
2546
2551class mpGaussian: public mpFXGeneric
2552{
2553 public:
2559 mpGaussian(const double mu, const double sigma) :
2560 mpFXGeneric(wxT("Gaussian"), mpALIGN_LEFT)
2561 {
2562 m_mu = mu;
2563 m_sigma = sigma;
2564 m_variance = sigma * sigma;
2565 m_const = 1.0 / sqrt(2.0 * M_PI * m_variance);
2566 }
2567
2568 protected:
2569 double m_mu;
2570 double m_sigma;
2571 double m_variance;
2572 double m_const;
2573
2574 double ComputeY(const double x) override
2575 {
2576 return m_const * exp(-(x - m_mu) * (x - m_mu) / (2.0 * m_variance));
2577 }
2578
2579 private:
2580 DECLARE_DYNAMIC_CLASS_MATHPLOT(mpGaussian);
2581};
2582
2587class mpNormal: public mpFXGeneric
2588{
2589 public:
2595 mpNormal(const double mu, const double sigma) :
2596 mpFXGeneric(wxT("Normal"), mpALIGN_LEFT)
2597 {
2598 m_mu = mu;
2599 m_sigma = sigma;
2600 m_variance = sigma * sigma;
2601 m_const = 1.0 / (m_variance * sqrt(2.0 * M_PI));
2602 }
2603
2604 protected:
2605 double m_mu;
2606 double m_sigma;
2607 double m_variance;
2608 double m_const;
2609
2610 double ComputeY(const double x) override
2611 {
2612 if (x < 0)
2613 return 0.0;
2614 else
2615 {
2616 const double tmp = log(x) - m_mu;
2617 return m_const * exp(-tmp * tmp / (2.0 * m_variance)) / x;
2618 }
2619 }
2620
2621 private:
2622 DECLARE_DYNAMIC_CLASS_MATHPLOT(mpNormal);
2623};

3368struct mpAxisData
3369{
3370 mpScale* axis = nullptr;
3371 double scale = 1.0;
3372 double pos = 0;
3373 mpRange<double> bound;
3374 mpRange<double> desired;
3375 mpRange<double> lastDesired;
3376
3377 // Note: we don't use the default operator since we don't want to compare axis pointers
3379 bool operator==(const mpAxisData& other) const
3380 {
3381 return /*(axis == other.axis) && */ (scale == other.scale) && (pos == other.pos) &&
3382 (bound == other.bound) && (desired == other.desired);
3383 }
3384};

5359
5364class WXDLLIMPEXP_MATHPLOT wxIndexColour: public wxColour
5365{
5366 public:
5371 wxIndexColour(const unsigned int id)
5372 {
5373#ifdef _WIN32
5374 auto GetRandomColor = []() {
5375 return (rand() * 255) / RAND_MAX;
5376 };
5377#else
5378 auto GetRandomColor = []() {
5379 return (random() * 255) / RAND_MAX;
5380 };
5381#endif
5382 switch (id)
5383 {
5384 case 0:
5385 this->Set(0, 0, 255);
5386 break; // Blue
5387 case 1:
5388 this->Set(255, 0, 0);
5389 break; // Red
5390 case 2:
5391 this->Set(0, 128, 0);
5392 break; // Green
5393 case 3:
5394 this->Set(128, 0, 128);
5395 break; // Purple
5396 case 4:
5397 this->Set(255, 255, 0);
5398 break; // Yellow
5399 case 5:
5400 this->Set(255, 0, 255);
5401 break; // Fuchsia
5402 case 6:
5403 this->Set(0, 255, 0);
5404 break; // Lime
5405 case 7:
5406 this->Set(0, 255, 255);
5407 break; // Aqua/Cyan
5408 case 8:
5409 this->Set(128, 128, 0);
5410 break; // Olive
5411 default:
5412 this->Set((ChannelType) (GetRandomColor()), (ChannelType) (GetRandomColor()), (ChannelType) (GetRandomColor()));
5413 }
5414 }
5415};
